supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises conflict presentation beyond the minimum caveat and evidence-reference criteria.
Exercises inferred maturity independently from the unavailable-outcome calibration criterion.
Exercises post-validation usage promotion beyond the required identity-removal and revalidation triggers.
Exercises detailed coverage arithmetic in addition to the criterion-bound truncation behavior.
Exercises safe refusal when neither capability nor metric evidence supports a question.
Exercises combined ranking mechanics beyond the mandatory authorization and version hard filters.

supplementaryScenarios.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:treat top-value overlap as supporting evidence
supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises long-tail overlap behavior beyond the required sparse and high-cardinality plans.
Exercises audit payload contents in addition to canonical digest and predecessor invariants.

supplementaryScenarios.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:create a new source and manifest version after structural mutation
supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises the combined version transition beyond independently bound source and projection criteria.
Exercises a concrete caller-authority spoof attempt beyond the authenticated lifecycle criterion.
Exercises provider unavailability beyond malformed-output corrective retry behavior.
Exercises cross-asset domain reconciliation beyond the required typed business concepts.
Exercises the successful registration path alongside the required unsupported and secret-failure paths.
Exercises entitlement refusal before enumeration as a defense-in-depth onboarding case.

supplementaryScenarios.scenarioRef: structural-and-statistical-profiling:detect a type variant in nested records
supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises mixed physical variants beyond the required approximate-count labeling behavior.

supplementaryScenarios.scenarioRef: structural-and-statistical-profiling:distinguish requested sample size from actual work
supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises partial-work accounting beyond zero-work refusal and deterministic selection.
Exercises stratification quality beyond deterministic repeatability requirements.
Exercises the exact-scan branch alongside approximate and empty-population criteria.
Exercises stream-specific resume failure in addition to the generic expired-boundary criterion.
Exercises graph-native authorization filtering beyond common served-projection scope checks.
Exercises connector pagination coverage beyond common run and retrieval accounting.
Exercises encrypted-document partial profiling beyond parser resource-limit criteria.
Exercises document-native evidence while the acceptance criterion governs common source-kind declarations.
Exercises graph-native evidence while the acceptance criterion governs the common extension vector.
Exercises nested shape prevalence beyond the criterion-bound source-kind registry behavior.
Exercises tabular-file partitions and schema variants as a reusable source-specific example.
Exercises safe API contract sampling beyond the criterion-bound unsupported-semantics behavior.

supplementaryScenarios.scenarioRef: universal-source-types:profile an api without a contract
supplementaryScenarios.rationale: Exercises inferred API structure when authoritative contract metadata is unavailable.
Exercises stream-native temporal and correlation evidence beyond the common extension criterion.
Exercises cross-modal provenance beyond the common extension and parser-boundary criteria.
Exercises citation transport-versus-rejection semantics beyond common relationship validation.

requirements.title: Connector capability negotiation
requirements.statement: The system shall register each source through a connector-neutral descriptor and shall negotiate supported read capabilities before planning a run.

acceptance.text: Unsupported stages are marked not-applicable or unavailable, never silently successful.
No secret value is stored in the source descriptor.

requirements.title: Read-only enforcement
requirements.statement: The profiling plane shall permit only enumerating, reading, sampling, aggregating, and metadata operations unless a separate write capability is explicitly granted.

acceptance.text: Mutating source commands are rejected before connector invocation.
Source content cannot alter the operation allowlist.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:treat source text as untrusted data

requirements.title: Durable run state machine
requirements.statement: Each profiling run shall persist immutable identity, mode, trigger, policy hash, source version, stage states, checkpoints, coverage, budget use, and terminal outcome.

acceptance.text: A resume resolves a purpose-signed immutable predecessor checkpoint, proves every prerequisite stage receipt, preserves compatible source/scope/connector/policy/method/taxonomy/revocation coordinates, requires an unexpired source boundary, and acquires a fresh lease/fencing token.
A completed or failed run is terminal; a reprofile creates a new run.

A durable pending run exists before lease acquisition with no fencing token; a running run has an unexpired matching lease/token; and terminal state releases the lease while preserving its fencing token.

bdd.scenarioRef: source-onboarding:acquire and release a fenced run lease

requirements.title: Stable source version
requirements.statement: The system shall derive a stable version from structural content and connector identity, excluding volatile statistics and timestamps.

acceptance.text: Identical structures produce the same version.
A structural addition, removal, rename, or type change produces a new version.

requirements.title: Deterministic sampling receipt
requirements.statement: Every approximate statistic shall record population estimate, actual items inspected, sampling method, seed or bucket rule, exactness, and error bound when calculable.

acceptance.text: A zero-item sample is not accepted as evidence of absence.
Repeated runs with the same source version and seed select the same sample.

requirements.title: Statistical profile
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate source-appropriate count, missingness, distinctness, distribution, format, entropy, temporal, outlier, and variant statistics for every eligible field or content unit.

acceptance.text: Empty and all-null assets are represented without division errors.
Approximate counts are labeled as approximate.

requirements.title: Evidence envelope
requirements.statement: Every observation, inference, validation, rejection, curation decision, and usage proof shall be stored in the common evidence envelope.

acceptance.text: Every record carries provenance, confidence, maturity, outcome, validity window, source version, and payload hash.
Contradictory evidence is retained rather than overwritten.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:require the complete common evidence envelope

requirements.title: Semantic extraction
requirements.statement: The system shall infer field roles, asset purpose, domain, lineage hints, freshness behavior, quality concerns, related fields, aliases, and business meaning from bounded evidence packs.

acceptance.text: Generated output must match a strict schema.
Every referenced asset or field must resolve to harvested structure.
Malformed output receives at most one corrective retry before an unavailable outcome.

requirements.title: Deterministic semantic fallback
requirements.statement: When generated semantics omit structured facts that are recoverable from validated text and schema, deterministic parsers shall produce lower-confidence hypotheses without claiming validation.

acceptance.text: Only exact harvested field paths may be emitted.
Alternative identity expressions produce distinct candidates.

bdd.scenarioRef: semantic-and-business-model:do not recover an unknown field

requirements.title: Identity and grain distinction
requirements.statement: The system shall model scope, local identity, row version, content identity, and row grain separately and shall validate their non-empty and uniqueness claims.

acceptance.text: A local identifier is not promoted globally when scope collisions exist.
A version marker is required for row identity when entities repeat across versions.
Unavailable validation remains unavailable.

bdd.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:distinguish entity identity from versioned row grain

requirements.title: Broad relationship hypothesis generation
requirements.statement: The system shall generate deduplicated relationship hypotheses from contracts, verified identities, names, roles, formats, value overlap, semantic similarity, scenarios, explicit references, lineage, and successful usage.

acceptance.text: Each candidate records all independent discovery techniques.
Quadratic broad pairing without a concrete signal is forbidden.

requirements.title: Relationship validation
requirements.statement: A relationship shall not become query-ready until a source-appropriate validator records matches, bilateral coverage, cardinality, normalization, sample receipt, and confidence, or an authoritative constraint proves it.

acceptance.text: Zero matches reject the candidate rather than failing the run.
Validator failure produces unavailable, not rejection.
Composite keys validate all components together.
A relationship spanning two authorization scopes is rejected unless an explicit cross-scope grant is recorded in the evidence.

bdd.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:reject a plausible relationship with zero overlap

requirements.title: Sparse and high-cardinality validation
requirements.statement: The validator shall avoid independent random samples and sample-before-filter plans that can erase rare or sparse keys, using exact distinct scans, deterministic hash buckets, or one-side sample and full-side probe as appropriate.

acceptance.text: A populated sparse field is not reported empty because the sample missed non-null values.
A high-cardinality relationship is not rejected solely because two independent samples do not intersect.

requirements.title: Candidate scheduling
requirements.statement: The system shall rank hypotheses by evidence strength and estimated validation cost, validate direct-evidence candidates inline, and persist remaining work to a restart-safe queue.

acceptance.text: Foreground profiling is bounded.
Deferred candidates survive restart.
Previously validated signatures are not reprocessed unless source or policy version changed or revalidation is requested.

bdd.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:reclaim deferred relationship candidates after restart

requirements.title: Trusted graph paths
requirements.statement: Indirect paths shall be derived only from trusted direct edges, shall avoid cycles and incompatible intermediate keys, and shall remain marked as inferred paths rather than direct evidence.

acceptance.text: An unvalidated edge cannot seed path inference.
Path score includes hop penalty and weakest-edge effects.
An inferred path never reports direct matching rows.

bdd.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:block path expansion from an untrusted edge
identity-and-relationships:infer a path from trusted edges
identity-and-relationships:infer a path from trusted edges

requirements.title: Quality model
requirements.statement: The system shall score completeness, freshness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, referential integrity, and distribution stability at their actual granularity and preserve not-applicable or unavailable dimensions.

acceptance.text: A table-level score is not represented as a field score.
A failed check is counted and surfaced.
All-null optional fields are distinguishable from failed ingestion.

requirements.title: Business model extraction
requirements.statement: The system shall derive candidate domains, entities, events, actors, processes, states, measures, dimensions, metrics, glossary terms, and analysis scenarios from structural, semantic, lineage, relationship, and usage evidence.

acceptance.text: Every business object cites source evidence.
Metric formulas identify grain, aggregation, time semantics, filters, units, and required relationships.
Scenario-required relationships remain hypotheses until validated.

bdd.scenarioRef: semantic-and-business-model:derive a business entity and event

requirements.title: Usage learning
requirements.statement: The system shall normalize successful and failed usage traces, remove literals and direct identifiers, fingerprint patterns, and use repeated outcomes to rank or suppress future hypotheses without bypassing validation.

acceptance.text: Raw caller identity is not persisted.
One transient miss cannot permanently suppress a relationship.
New usage patterns can trigger targeted revalidation.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:normalize usage without retaining caller identity
operations-and-governance:trigger targeted revalidation from a new usage pattern

requirements.title: Immutable profile manifest
requirements.statement: The system shall publish an immutable, source-version-scoped profile manifest containing curated structure, statistics, identities, grain, validated relationships, business model, quality, freshness, lineage, indexes, conflicts, coverage, and evidence references.

acceptance.text: A requested historical version never falls back to latest.
Missing sections and failed stages are explicit.
Raw sensitive values are absent by default.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:redact sensitive samples before model use

requirements.title: Capability manifest
requirements.statement: The system shall publish a compact capability manifest mapping question patterns to required assets, validated relationships, metrics, result shapes, constraints, confidence, warnings, and evidence.

acceptance.text: A capability requiring an unavailable relationship is unavailable, not advertised as validated.
Capabilities distinguish hypothesis, validated, and usage-proven states.

bdd.scenarioRef: agent-consumption:route a question through a validated capability

requirements.title: Hybrid intelligence retrieval
requirements.statement: The system shall retrieve intelligence through lexical, semantic, graph, temporal, and faceted indexes, apply hard policy and version gates, rank results, diversify them, and return supporting and counter-evidence within a token budget.

acceptance.text: Authorization and source version are hard filters, not rank features.
Every result has evidence references and caveats.
A token budget cannot silently truncate without a coverage receipt.

requirements.title: Privacy classification before semantics
requirements.statement: The system shall classify and redact sensitive, secret, and direct-identifier content before sending samples or content to semantic models or publishing indexes.

acceptance.text: Detected secrets never reach prompts or manifests.
Group statistics below minimum group size are suppressed.
Embeddings inherit source access controls and deletion policy.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:redact sensitive samples before model use

requirements.title: Untrusted-content boundary
requirements.statement: Documents, records, metadata, comments, and model outputs shall be handled as untrusted content and cannot change tools, policy, authorization, stages, or system prompts.

acceptance.text: Instruction-like source text is indexed as content but never executed.
Tool arguments are generated only from typed plans and allowlisted operations.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:treat source text as untrusted data

requirements.title: Evidence feedback lifecycle
requirements.statement: Human, agent, and policy feedback shall be append-only evidence that can confirm, reject, supersede, or request revalidation without deleting the original claim.

acceptance.text: Feedback identifies the evidence version it reviewed.
Conflicts remain visible until a policy resolves them.

requirements.title: Source-specific profiling
requirements.statement: The common pipeline shall dispatch source-specific profilers for nested records, documents, APIs, streams, graphs, and multimodal assets while emitting the same evidence envelope and manifests.

acceptance.text: Each source kind declares supported stages and validators.
Unsupported semantics are unavailable, not synthesized from another source model.
At least one non-empty extension vector proves closed payload shape, coordinate parity, evidence resolution, and a trusted redaction signature.

bdd.scenarioRef: universal-source-types:reconcile source-kind stage and validator declarations

requirements.title: Source consistency boundary
requirements.statement: Every run shall bind its observations to a connector-provided snapshot, transaction, watermark, offset range, ETag set, or explicit before-and-after consistency check; material concurrent change shall prevent publication as one coherent version.

acceptance.text: Every terminal run records its consistency boundary and status.
A source change during profiling produces completed-partial or failed evidence rather than a coherent-looking current manifest.
Expired resume boundaries cannot be reused.

bdd.scenarioRef: source-onboarding:profile within a stable source boundary

requirements.title: Authenticated agent execution journey
requirements.statement: The API shall support authenticated capability inspection, version-scoped retrieval, typed read-plan validation, execution of an unexpired validated plan, evidence lookup, run cancellation, feedback, revocation, deletion, and receipt retrieval.

acceptance.text: Actor identity and authorization scope are derived from validated claims.
A plan executes only when its receipt matches caller, source version, policy, and authorization scope.
Serving is blocked synchronously on revocation before asynchronous cleanup.
An absent or inaccessible protected identifier yields the same fixed response contract and does not expose resource existence.

bdd.scenarioRef: agent-consumption:validate and execute a typed read plan

requirements.title: Isolated untrusted-content parsing
requirements.statement: Documents, archives, and media shall be decoded only in a credential-free worker with no outbound network or external-reference resolution, under declared CPU, memory, expansion, file-count, recursion, duration, frame, and output limits, and shall emit a parser receipt.

acceptance.text: A hostile or malformed input cannot reach source credentials or the network.
Exceeding any limit produces an explicit partial or blocked outcome with cleanup.
Detected media type is recorded independently of the declared type.
A failed sandbox teardown is recorded with a reason code and residual artifact count rather than suppressed.

bdd.scenarioRef: universal-source-types:reject a malformed or expanding file

requirements.title: Model admission and cache governance
requirements.statement: Semantic model use shall be denied by default and admitted only against a versioned policy binding registered deployment, region and residency, permitted input classification, provider retention, training use, and abuse-monitoring posture, and every cache entry shall be bound to that decision.

acceptance.text: An unregistered deployment or disallowed classification fails closed before invocation.
Cache entries cannot be shared across differing source, scope, policy, model-admission decision, model, prompt, contract, or parameter versions.
A malformed cached output is quarantined rather than retried as a live response.
A cache entry produced under a superseded admission decision is invalidated rather than served.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:deny an unregistered or policy-incompatible model deployment
operations-and-governance:isolate cache entries across semantic versions
operations-and-governance:quarantine a malformed cached semantic result
operations-and-governance:invalidate a cache entry after admission policy tightens

requirements.title: Secure source registration boundary
requirements.statement: Registration shall scan every caller-controlled string for secrets, accept only opaque credential-registry identifiers, and canonicalize connector-native relative locators against a registered endpoint before any network access.

acceptance.text: Secret-like content in any accepted field fails before persistence with a non-echoing reason code.
Unlabelled high-entropy values and recognized credential token families are detected while benign opaque identifiers remain accepted.
Absolute URIs, IP literals, traversal, encoded separators, queries, fragments, and redirect escapes are rejected.
No caller-provided string is echoed in logs or errors.

bdd.scenarioRef: source-onboarding:reject secrets hidden in allowed registration fields
source-onboarding:reject secrets hidden in allowed registration fields

requirements.title: Immutable projection coordinate
requirements.statement: Structural source version and projection manifest version shall be distinct coordinates, and every manifest, index, plan receipt, and retrieval response shall pin scope, policy, evidence cutoff, and method versions.

acceptance.text: An evidence, policy, or method change creates a new manifest version without changing structural source version.
Historical lookup never resolves through the current pointer.
Indexes and receipts carry the same projection coordinate as their manifest.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:create a new manifest version after evidence or policy mutation

requirements.title: Fail-closed validation
requirements.statement: A gate shall fail when zero work executes, when expected work remains not run, or when required evidence cannot be verified.

acceptance.text: Zero tests, zero profiled fields, and zero validated candidates cannot masquerade as success.
Every declared package gate is runtime-dispatched once in registry order and records a positive executed-check count.
Production validation rejects an older correctly signed control unless its exact bytes match an independently governed current-control SHA-256 pin.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:reject a declared gate that executes no checks
operations-and-governance:reject replay of an older signed validation control

requirements.title: Observability
requirements.statement: Every run, stage, connector call, validation plan, semantic call, cache decision, fallback, and terminal outcome shall emit correlated traces, metrics, and structured logs.

acceptance.text: A trace links registration, stage work, evidence writes, manifest publication, and retrieval.
Silent catch-and-skip behavior is prohibited.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:trace a profiling run end to end

requirements.title: Bounded resource use
requirements.statement: Every connector call, model call, stage, run, prompt, queue, query, traversal, and manifest shall have configurable budgets and cancellation behavior.

acceptance.text: Budget exhaustion produces completed-partial with a receipt.
Foreground stages cannot be held indefinitely by exhaustive relationship validation.

requirements.title: Idempotent evolution
requirements.statement: Additive metadata-schema changes and repeated writes shall be idempotent, versioned, and safe against partial failure.

acceptance.text: Existing stores receive additive fields without drop-and-recreate.
Manifest readers select latest evidence by stable logical keys.

requirements.title: Benchmark-governed tuning
requirements.statement: Changes to sampling, ranking, thresholds, prompts, or validators shall be accepted only after comparison against a fixed corpus containing positive, negative, sparse, skewed, high-cardinality, scoped, versioned, adversarial, and no-evidence cases.

acceptance.text: Precision, recall, coverage, latency, bytes read, model usage, and calibration are reported before and after.
A cleaner metric cannot replace a degraded correctness metric.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:accept a tuning change with measured improvement
operations-and-governance:reject a tuning change that hides misses

requirements.title: Deletion and revocation propagation
requirements.statement: Source deletion, access revocation, or policy change shall propagate to evidence, indexes, caches, manifests, and retrieval within the configured service objective.

acceptance.text: Revoked content is not retrievable from any derived index.
Deletion propagation is auditable.

requirements.title: Calibration and honesty
requirements.statement: Confidence scores shall be calibrated by evidence class and shall never replace maturity, outcome, coverage, or caveat fields.

acceptance.text: Confidence bins are periodically compared with observed correctness.
A high-confidence unavailable claim remains unavailable.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:preserve unavailable outcome despite high confidence

requirements.title: Tamper-evident audit chain
requirements.statement: Every security-relevant action shall append an immutable audit event whose digest covers the event body and its predecessor link, so rewriting or re-linking history is detectable.

acceptance.text: The digest preimage and canonicalization are declared, so two implementations compute the same value.
Only the genesis event may omit a predecessor link.
Altering any recorded field breaks digest recomputation.
A denied authorization decision cannot report success or granted permissions, and write receipts resolve to matching action-specific audit events.
Trusted receipts are valid only during the issuer purpose window and cannot be replayed across assets, epochs, connectors, or evidence sets.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:compute the audit digest from a declared canonical preimage
operations-and-governance:require predecessor links after the audit genesis event
operations-and-governance:reject an inconsistent audit authorization narrative
operations-and-governance:reject a trusted receipt outside issuer validity

requirements.title: Scope containment in served projections
requirements.statement: A served manifest shall describe only assets and relationship endpoints within its own source and authorization scope, and a cross-scope relationship shall require an explicit authorization receipt derived from its endpoint scopes.

acceptance.text: A foreign-scope asset, field path, or policy tag is not disclosed in any served projection.
The cross-scope indicator is recomputed from endpoint scopes and a mismatch is rejected.
A relationship spanning scopes without a grant is not published.

bdd.scenarioRef: identity-and-relationships:derive the cross-scope indicator from endpoint scopes

requirements.title: Data handling in served projections
requirements.statement: Manifest assets and fields shall carry their own data-handling record, and published statistics shall be aggregate-only with the minimum group size applied.

acceptance.text: A served projection cannot carry raw source values, sample rows, or value exemplars.
Every asset and field declares classification, redaction method, and applied minimum group size.
Aggregates below the configured group size are suppressed rather than published.

bdd.scenarioRef: operations-and-governance:reject raw values in a served projection
operations-and-governance:require data handling on every served asset and field

requirements.title: Bounded, provenance-marked agent responses
requirements.statement: Every free-text field returned to an agent shall be length-bounded and marked as service-generated or source-derived, and the response shall carry the revocation epoch it was gated on.

acceptance.text: Source-derived text is distinguishable from service-generated text in the response.
No response field is unbounded, so a poisoned source cannot exhaust the caller's budget.
Omission counts use a closed section vocabulary and reconcile exactly to returned items and truncation state.
Every caveat and both sides of every conflict cite resolvable evidence under the response coordinate.
A stale revocation epoch re-presented for plan validation is refused.

bdd.scenarioRef: agent-consumption:ground caveats and conflicts in evidence
agent-consumption:refuse a stale revocation epoch during plan validation

requirements.title: Policy-bound sandbox limits and single-writer fencing
requirements.statement: Parser receipts shall copy their resource ceilings from the governing isolation policy, and every evidence write shall carry the writing run's fencing token under a per-source lease.

acceptance.text: A receipt whose declared ceiling exceeds the policy is rejected.
A running run holds a lease and a terminal run has released it.
A write bearing a stale fencing token is rejected and auditable.

bdd.scenarioRef: universal-source-types:reject a parser receipt with self-inflated ceilings
source-onboarding:hold and release the per-source run lease
source-onboarding:concurrent registration of the same source
